sentence: A shared sign-up list where each item can be claimed by up to two people, who can join or leave an item, and anyone can add new items.
use_when: Sorting out who brings what to a party or potluck
Splitting up supplies or chores with a small limit per item
Group wants to see which items are still unclaimed
Need a quick tap-to-join list in a chat
dont_use_when: Voting between options or picking a date
Splitting costs or tracking who owes money
Assigning time slots or a schedule
Tracking tasks with due dates and status
